title: Channel ledger (.github/channels/<channel>.json)
description: Reviewed state of one update channel. The unsigned manifest body is a pure function of this file, the release records and the trust chain; channel_ledger.py is the validator.

reason.description: A version moves back only with a reason starting 'yank <bad version>'.

history.description: Every version ever served per install_source; append only.

published_at.description: UTC time each version was first published on this channel, per install_source; append only. Never decreases along history. Not part of a reviewed ledger file: the publisher writes it into the archived ledger snapshot from the manifest's generated_at (its own clock); a ledger file that carries it is refused.

full_rollout_at.description: UTC time each version first reached a 100% rollout on this channel, per install_source; append only. Not part of a reviewed ledger file: the publisher stamps it from the manifest's generated_at into the archived snapshot. The promoting channel's soak period (SOAK_DAYS) is measured from it, read from the source channel's served snapshot.

rollout_history.description: Per install_source and version: the highest rollout it was ever served at and whether it was ever withdrawn (kill-switched, or taken to 0% after being served); append only. The promoting channel requires 100 and never withdrawn.

withdrawn_versions.description: Yanked versions; append only; carried into the manifest body.

app_build_tombstones.description: Withdrawn (kill-switched, 0% or yanked) app_bundle releases; append only. A tombstoned Sparkle build number may never be reused by another version. Read by the Apple release preflight.
